bass.rule: tuning: ±10 c in the asked octave at E1–G3; loudness: U08.L05's bass within ±1.5 LU of ebass; headphones: at most 9 dB of a note lost below 80 Hz (E1, A1, E2); kick: in the 40 ms after each kick the kick carries at least half the energy (≥ −3 dB) and the mix rises by ≥ 6 dB

blues.rule: tuning ±10 c at E2–B♭4 incl. the blue ♭5 (B♭) (the acoustic piano's stretched bass ±15 c at E2); octave by YIN, or by the spectrum when YIN locks onto a strong 2nd harmonic (fundamental ≥ −6 dB and 3rd harmonic ≥ −20 dB of the strongest); the same E-blues riff and the same C7 F7 G7 comping within ±3 LU of the piano; every voice of each seventh ≥ −12 dB of the chord

cpu.rule: live (what decides): 8 s of the chorus at its tempo and 10 s of the whole piece at twice its tempo, with no audio underrun (AudioContext.playbackStats), no main-thread stall over 200 ms and, where Chrome reports AudioContext.renderCapacity, an audio-thread peak load under 0.7; offline: 90 s renders faster than real time (recorded with a kick-only baseline; an offline render keeps ended voices connected until the main thread can release them, so its cost grows with length and is not the live headroom)

preload.rule: the C3 arrangement at 4× speed on a pack that answers every audio file 700 ms late: every sound the chorus brings is fetched and decoded before bar 9; no skipped note; nothing leaves 127.0.0.1

probes.rule: envelope level within 0.08 of adsrCurve at each point; echoes at k × 0.45 s (±12 ms) falling by the default feedback 0.5 (−6 dB, ±2 dB); filter response within ±2 dB of filterCurve up to an octave past the cutoff (±4 dB beyond)
